subjects.pose: Stationary vehicle parked at the roadside curb
subjects.action: Stopped with red lights flashing and stop arm deployed

subjects.relationship: The vulnerable road user the ego vehicle must yield to; crosses in front of the stopped bus

background_setting: A quiet two-lane suburban residential road under clear daytime skies. Neatly trimmed grass verges, sidewalks and low hedges line both sides, with single-family homes, driveways and mature trees set back from the road. Utility poles and a few parked cars appear in the distance. The asphalt is dry with faded lane markings and a broken center line, and consistent hard shadows fall across the pavement from the overhead sun.

lighting.shadows: Crisp, well-defined shadows cast consistently to one side of vehicles, trees and the child
lighting.illumination_effect: High-contrast, vivid daytime clarity with saturated colors and good visibility

aesthetics.color_scheme: Yellow bus and red jacket accents against green foliage, gray asphalt and blue sky
aesthetics.mood_atmosphere: Calm suburban routine, cautionary, safety-focused tension
aesthetics.patterns: Repeating lane markings, roadside trees and evenly spaced utility poles

cinematography.focus: Sharp on the road ahead, the school bus and the crossing child

context: Autonomous driving safety demonstration of yielding to a stopped school bus and a crossing child pedestrian

actions.description: Ego vehicle travels forward along the suburban road, approaching the yellow school bus stopped in the oncoming lane with red lights flashing and stop arm extended.
A child-sized figure steps off the curb in front of the bus and begins walking across the road toward the ego lane.
The vehicle applies smooth, firm, continuous braking. Its speed decreases steadily through the entire two seconds and it reaches a complete standstill by 0:03.5.

The vehicle comes to a complete stop well before the crossing point and remains fully stationary as the child continues across; the vehicle is parked and perfectly stationary and the camera does not move at all.

temporal_caption: At 0:00, ego vehicle travels forward along the suburban road, approaching the yellow school bus stopped in the oncoming lane with red lights flashing and stop arm extended.
